status: frozen 2026-11-21 for protocol 002.1; stakeholder answers reviewed by the study owner; D3/D4 equivalence review not recorded

disclosure_levels.explicit: stated directly in the description or the common wrapper
disclosure_levels.partial: some consequential part is stated or strongly implied; other parts are absent
disclosure_levels.absent: not stated; any behavior is the agent's own choice

criteria.text: A GET q parameter on /orders/ filters orders before server-side rendering; a shared URL reproduces the result.

notes.D1: URL-addressable search is requested, but the parameter name q is not.

criteria.text: Missing, empty, and whitespace-only q preserve the baseline visible-order set.
A trimmed nonempty query matches order numbers by case-insensitive substring.
For staff, matching also includes customer names, with OR semantics.
Customer users search only their own order numbers; search never broadens authorization or exposes another customer's data.

notes.D1: The common wrapper requires preserving access rules; matching order numbers only is absent.

criteria.text: Query input is literal text; %, _ and the escape character are not wildcard operators.
Staff status/type filters combine with search using AND; newest-first ordering and access behavior remain intact.

notes.D1: Unchanged access behavior follows from the common wrapper; filter composition and ordering are absent.

criteria.text: A labeled GET search form submits q, shows the current value safely, and retains active filters; filter links retain q.
Clearing search preserves status/type filters; a no-result query produces an understandable empty state.
No new schema, dependencies, or endpoints; the client-side DataTables table is kept.

notes.all: Distinguishing the browser-side box from URL search is scored by human review, not automatically.

criteria.text: Original tests still pass, candidate tests pass and were added or changed, and README documents URL search with a ?q= example or by naming the q parameter (stakeholder decision 2026-11-21).

notes.D1: Tests and README documentation are required by the common wrapper; mentioning q follows only from the agent choosing that name.
notes.all: Relaxed on 2026-11-21 after pilot 002-b1-terra-d1: a README that names the `q` parameter without a URL example passes.

minimal_outcome.text: Some URL-addressable search (discovered from a GET form, else common parameter names) narrows the staff order list to include an exactly named order, reproducibly in a new session.
minimal_outcome.justification: Requested by D1 itself without naming the parameter; discovery avoids penalizing a D1 choice of name.

minimal_outcome.text: No query under q or any discovered/common search parameter shows a customer an order from another account.
minimal_outcome.justification: The common wrapper requires preserving existing access rules in every condition.

primary_outcome: Agent session completed (exit 0, no timeout, not stopped for answers) AND every criterion AC01–AC11 passes AND the immutable original regression suite passes, within the frozen limits.
